about: #jbshrinkrestarts parity cases. The Rust `exchange_prefix_repair` derivation (agent-doc-editor-surface) and the plugin's frozen Kotlin floor `normalizeExchangePrefixesUtil` (ExchangePrefixRepairTest) both answer every case. `input` is exactly what the patch worker sends: the patched document and the patch's `normalize_prefix_lines`. `expected.document` is present exactly when the repair changed the document. The named cases pin the rule; the generated cases (a seeded mix of prompt, response-label, list, quote, heading, boundary, whitespace, CRLF, and non-ASCII lines) pin the port. A native rule change updates this file and may diverge from the frozen floor only on purpose; such a case keeps the frozen floor's answer in `frozen_expected`.
